content.json:
# Infrastructure Health

VM availability, heartbeat status, disk/memory/CPU utilization, and Azure resource health.

content.title: VM Availability Summary

content.query:
// Offline VMs (no heartbeat in 5 minutes)
Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer, ResourceGroup, OSType, _ResourceId
| where LastHeartbeat < ago(5m)
| extend MinutesSinceLastBeat = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastHeartbeat)
| order by MinutesSinceLastBeat desc
| project Computer, ResourceGroup, OSType, LastHeartbeat, MinutesSinceLastBeat
content.title: Offline VMs
CPU Utilization by VM

content.query:
// Memory Available (MB) - Bottom 10
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'Memory' and CounterName == 'Available MBytes'
| summarize AvgAvailableMB = avg(CounterValue) by Computer
| order by AvgAvailableMB asc
| take 10
content.title: Bottom 10 VMs by Available Memory

content.query:
// Disk Free Space % by VM
Perf
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ObjectName == 'LogicalDisk' and CounterName == '% Free Space' and InstanceName != '_Total'
| summarize AvgFreePercent = avg(CounterValue) by Computer, InstanceName
| where AvgFreePercent < 20
| order by AvgFreePercent asc
content.title: Low Disk Space (< 20% Free)
Aggregate CPU Trend

content.query:
// Azure Resource Health events
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where CategoryValue == 'ResourceHealth'
| project TimeGenerated, Resource = _ResourceId, Level, OperationNameValue, Properties = Properties_d
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Recent Resource Health Events
